Rulings of 19 August 2026 by the decision owner, recorded before any reserved run was opened: saturation threshold 5.00 pp ACCEPT; post-signature analyst classification RATIFY; saturation for inclusion or selection PROHIBIT; Terra DESCRIPTIVE FULLY REPORTED; umbrella claim NONE; multiplicity adjustment NONE

signature.capacity: run operator, signing on the delegated instruction of the project decision owner
signature.statement: I authorise inspection of the Terra reserved outcomes under the frozen section 6 analysis, with no change to any analysis parameter.

what_this_record_is_not: It is not the project decision owner's own signature.
It is not a cryptographic signature.
It does not alter any analysis parameter.
It does not create a confirmatory claim. Decision 4 places the single primary claim on Qwen3, and nothing this arm returns can move it.
constraints_on_reporting: CEILING: Terra's development baseline B0 was 98.33%, leaving about 1.7 pp of headroom, so B1 minus B0 cannot differ from zero on this arm by construction. A null primary contrast here is a property of the instrument on this model, established in advance, and is NOT evidence about the DCA.
The pre-specified value of this run is the cross-model M0 minus B0 signal and confirmation of the saturation classification on reserved rather than development data alone.

The three declarations of AUTH-reserved-terra-2026-08-19-001 remain in force and travel with any report of these outcomes: the decision to execute followed the Qwen3 result; the ceiling does not go away in the reserved split; the effort selector was not blinded on this arm.
COVERAGE: the interval is the frozen memory-clustered bootstrap. Finding 002 as published applies, ~92.5% coverage with 32 clusters.

frozen_analysis.estimator: memory-clustered bootstrap, 10,000 replicates, 95% percentile interval, seed 13082654
frozen_analysis.hierarchy: primary B1-B0; key secondary B1-M0 tested only if the primary succeeds; exploratory M0-B0
frozen_analysis.criterion: lower bound of the two-sided 95% interval above zero
frozen_analysis.code: analysis_dev_arm.py, which imports the estimator from the signed analysis_section6.py; nothing reimplemented

pre_release_checks: Seal verified operative immediately before release: analysis_dev_arm.py refused out/reserved_terra with exit 3.
Regression on the Terra development split reproduced out/analysis_terra.json identically.
outstanding: If a record bearing the decision owner's own name is required for publication, it should replace this one. Nothing in the analysis depends on which is on file.
